groups.label: Layout and text
groups.note: The core building blocks you drop into almost any section.

settings.label: Heading
settings.desc: Type [br] where you want the line to break.

settings.label: Color
settings.desc: Follows the color scheme. Edit the palette under Theme settings > Colors.

settings.label: Italic / marked word colour
settings.desc: Colours italic text in the heading. With the Highlight or Circled word decoration, that is the word you italicised to mark.

settings.label: Decoration style
settings.desc: Overrides the theme default decoration for this heading. "Use theme default" follows Theme settings > Typography. For Circled word and Highlight marker, italicize the word or phrase to mark in the heading text; without italics the last word is marked.

settings.label: Text
settings.desc: Type [br] where you want the line to break.

settings.label: HTML tag
settings.desc: Changes the HTML element, not the look. Use Quote for a pull quote and Caption for text describing an image.

settings.label: Color
settings.desc: Follows the color scheme. Edit the palette under Theme settings > Colors.

settings.label: Link
settings.desc: A link to a page, product, or collection.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.desc: Picks which colour scheme this section uses.

settings.label: Custom icon
settings.desc: Optional. Overrides the glyph above. An SVG uploaded to Files works best; a transparent PNG is fine too. Your file keeps its own colours, so it will not follow the icon colour setting. Paste the SVG code below instead if you want it to.

settings.label: Custom icon (SVG code)
settings.desc: Optional. Paste the SVG source. Takes priority over the uploaded image, and because it is drawn inline it follows the icon colour and size settings, as long as the SVG uses currentColor rather than a hard-coded fill.

settings.label: Accessible label
settings.desc: Optional. Adds a screen-reader name; leave blank for a decorative icon.

settings.label: Image
settings.desc: An image you upload or pick from files.

settings.label: Priority load (LCP)
settings.desc: Enable for the one above-the-fold LCP image per page. Leave off elsewhere.

settings.label: Link
settings.desc: A link to a page, product, or collection.

settings.label: Make the whole card a link
settings.desc: Adds an invisible overlay so the whole card is clickable. Needs a nested heading or text block to carry the link text.

settings.label: Distribution
settings.desc: Distributes free vertical space, so it only has an effect when the group is taller than its contents — stretched inside a grid or given a minimum height.

settings.label: Gap
settings.desc: In a grid this is the gap between columns. Row gap sets the space between rows.

settings.label: Use a different gap on mobile
Minimum height
settings.desc: 0 = fits content. Distribute settings need spare height to do anything.

settings.label: Column span
settings.desc: Applies only when this group sits directly inside a group set to Grid. Spans drop back to one cell on mobile.

settings.label: Row span
settings.desc: Applies only when this group sits directly inside a group set to Grid. Spans drop back to one cell on mobile.

settings.label: Display
settings.desc: Overlay lifts this group out of the layout and pins it over the block behind it, such as a product image. Its blocks still stack by direction and gap.

settings.label: Show only the highest-priority badge
settings.desc: Hides every badge in this group except the one with the lowest priority number.

settings.label: Background
settings.desc: Turns this group into a card. Every layout setting above still applies.

settings.label: Background image
settings.desc: An image you upload or pick from files.

settings.label: Overlay
settings.desc: Darkens the image so text on top stays readable.

settings.label: Use a different color scheme
settings.desc: Repaints everything inside this group. Leave off to follow the section.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.desc: Colors the text and buttons sitting on the image.

groups.label: Product and commerce
groups.note: Blocks for product pages and product cards: the buy area, pricing, variants, stock, and delivery.

settings.label: Size
settings.desc: Editorial gives the image more room to breathe — use it in spotlight or editorial layouts, not dense grids.

settings.label: Hover effect
settings.desc: Changes the product image on hover (desktop only). The gallery options need a product with two or more images.

settings.label: On a phone
settings.desc: Phones have no hover, so the effect above does nothing there. Swipe turns the card image into a track the shopper can swipe through, with dots below. Needs a product with two or more images.

settings.label: Custom icon
settings.desc: Optional. Overrides the glyph above. An SVG uploaded to Files works best; a transparent PNG is fine too. Your file keeps its own colours, so it will not follow the icon colour setting. Paste the SVG code below instead if you want it to.

settings.label: Custom icon (SVG code)
settings.desc: Optional. Paste the SVG source. Takes priority over the uploaded image, and because it is drawn inline it follows the icon colour and size settings, as long as the SVG uses currentColor rather than a hard-coded fill.

settings.label: Metafield (namespace.key)
settings.desc: A product metafield list of strings, e.g. custom.benefits. Overrides the manual lines when set.

settings.label: Manual lines
settings.desc: One benefit per line. Used only when the metafield above is empty.

settings.label: Metafield (namespace.key)
settings.desc: Used when source is Product metafield, e.g. custom.subtitle.

settings.label: Max lines (0 = no clamp)
settings.desc: Truncates after this many lines. Set 0 to show the full text.

settings.label: Metafield (namespace.key)
settings.desc: Used when source is Product metafield. A rich-text or multi-line product metafield, e.g. custom.nutrition.

settings.label: Savings appearance
settings.desc: Chip is the default and matches the sale badge tint. Solid takes the accent fill — remember only one element per tile should carry it, and a sale badge usually already does.

settings.label: Savings text
settings.desc: Write your own, using [amount] and [percent] where the numbers go — "Save [amount]", "[percent]% off", "Save [amount] ([percent]%)". Leave it empty to use the translated default.

settings.label: Keep the savings row when not on sale
settings.desc: Holds the row open on full-price products so a mixed row of sale and full-price cards keeps one baseline. Turn it off only where every product is on sale.

settings.label: Button emphasis
settings.desc: Tinted and outlined give up the accent fill while keeping the full hit area. Use one of them on product grids: a filled accent on every card stops reading as an accent, and where cards also carry a sale badge only one element should take the fill.

settings.label: Button size
settings.desc: Compact takes one step off the padding and label. On product cards the button already steps down on mobile on its own.

settings.label: Button style
settings.desc: Icon only sizes the button to itself instead of stretching to the card's width.

settings.label: Show dynamic checkout button
settings.desc: Shows the customer's one-click checkout buttons (Shop Pay, PayPal…).

settings.label: Custom icon
settings.desc: Optional. Overrides the glyph above. An SVG uploaded to Files works best; a transparent PNG is fine too. Your file keeps its own colours, so it will not follow the icon colour setting. Paste the SVG code below instead if you want it to.

settings.label: Custom icon (SVG code)
settings.desc: Optional. Paste the SVG source. Takes priority over the uploaded image, and because it is drawn inline it follows the icon colour and size settings, as long as the SVG uses currentColor rather than a hard-coded fill.

settings.label: Fallback content
settings.desc: Shown when no page is selected above.

settings.label: Text
settings.desc: Leave blank to hide the badge. Connect a metafield here to show it only on the products that carry one. On a sale badge, put [percent] where the discount number should go — "Save [percent]%", "[percent]% off", "−[percent]%".

settings.label: Append the discount percent
settings.desc: Only applies when the label does not already place the number itself. Put [percent] in the label to control where it goes and whether it carries a sign.

settings.label: Trigger tag
settings.desc: Badge shows on products tagged with this word in Shopify admin. Capitals are ignored.

settings.label: Priority
settings.desc: Sets the order badges stack in, 1 first. Turn on the group's badge override to show only the highest one.

settings.label: Use a different color scheme
settings.desc: Repaints just this badge. Add a scheme under Theme settings > Colors to create a new badge color.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.desc: Picks which colour scheme this section uses.

settings.label: Border width
settings.desc: Leave at 0 to keep the fill's own border. Outline draws its own.

settings.label: Tilt
settings.desc: Follows the theme style. Styles with no tilt stay flat, and reduced motion flattens all of them.

settings.label: Hover effect
settings.desc: How the badge reacts when the card it sits on is hovered. Following the card means it also stays still when the card's own hover effect is off.

settings.label: Category marker
settings.desc: Shopify menus carry no per-link settings, so dots and icons are read from the linked collection’s metafield.

settings.label: Marker metafield
settings.desc: namespace.key of a collection metafield. For a colour dot it should hold a colour; for an icon, one of: leaf, cup, stick, shield, truck, recycle, check, return, lock, drop, swirl, no-spoon, mesh-brew.

settings.label: Quick add button
settings.desc: Overlays the product image. Single-variant products add to cart in one tap; multi-variant products link to the product page.

settings.label: Quick view button
settings.desc: Opens a dialog to pick a variant and add to cart without leaving the page. Products with two or more option types link to the product page instead.

settings.label: Show a "view product" bar
settings.desc: A bar across the bottom of the picture linking to the product. It slides up on hover with a mouse, and is always visible on a touch screen. A gentler alternative to an add-to-cart button on the card.

settings.label: On mobile
settings.desc: A full-width bar sits over the picture the whole time on a touch screen, since there is no hover to reveal it. A pill takes up much less of the product.

settings.label: Spec metafield
settings.desc: Namespace and key, e.g. custom.specs. The value is one "Label: Value" per line. Cards whose product has no value simply omit this block.

settings.label: Rows to show
settings.desc: Keep this low on a dense grid; two rows reads cleanly at four or five columns.

settings.label: Media size
settings.desc: Share of the card given to the image rather than the copy.

settings.label: Load image eagerly
settings.desc: Turn on for the first slide only so its image is not lazy-loaded (helps LCP). Leave off for the rest.

settings.label: Text overlay opacity

settings.label: Show the first one on the tile
settings.desc: A small tag over the foot of the tile (under the circle on the stories layout). All tagged products appear in the viewer regardless.

settings.label: Button on the tile
settings.desc: Automatic picks per product: add to cart when there is one variant, quick view when there is one option to choose, otherwise the product page. A forced choice falls back the same way when a product cannot support it.

settings.label: Show "add all" in the viewer
settings.desc: One button under the shoppable strip that adds the whole look in a single step. Only products with one available variant can be included, so it appears once two or more of them qualify.
